context: Naoko and Hina-young have a long open chat about teenage life.
purpose: Aunt and teen sharing honest big-life talk.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ひな、最近、どう過ごしてる?
lines.en: Hina, how have you been doing lately?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening — the kind of aunt who genuinely wants to know. Soft Kansai lilt, patient. Leaning in slightly, full attention.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、いろいろ悩んでる。
lines.en: Well, I've got a lot on my mind these days.
lines.style: Hesitant start, then honest. Quiet but not withdrawn — trusting the listener. Steady pace, slight vulnerability underneath.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Gentle probe, no pressure. Warm Kansai softness. The pause before the question shows she's listening, not just waiting to speak.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: It's my friendships — they're complicated right now.
lines.style: Quiet and honest. The kind of admission that costs something. Slight catch in the voice, but steady. Not looking for pity, just saying it true.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: When you're young, everyone goes through that.
lines.style: Reassuring, but not dismissive. Knowing tone — she's lived it. Warm Kansai cadence, unhurried. The wisdom is in the gentleness, not the words.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Do you really think my dreams can come true?
lines.style: Uncertain, reaching. Small voice asking big things. A tremor of hope and fear mixed. Trails slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: If you work at it, absolutely they will.
lines.style: Firmer now, conviction underneath. Light emphasis on the certainty — not aggressive, but solid. Warm Kansai strength showing through. She means this.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Soft admiration. Not gushing — genuine observation. Almost surprised at her own recognition of it. Small, warm voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: You're a strong one too, you know.
lines.style: Tender but certain. Not coddling — stating fact. Warm Kansai affection. The kind of thing that lands because she's actually seen you.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Thank you. That makes me so happy.
lines.style: Genuine relief and warmth. The gratitude is real. Soft ending, like a small exhale of being heard.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: いつでも、相談しに来てな。
lines.en: Come talk to me anytime you need to, all right?
lines.style: Open door, no conditions. Warm Kansai reassurance. Steady, reliable tone — this is a promise she keeps. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、おばちゃん、大好き!
lines.en: Yeah, I love you so much, Auntie!
lines.style: Bright and sudden — the affection breaking through. Genuine warmth, no performance. Light, happy, uninhibited.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Warm laugh, genuine delight. Kansai warmth at full strength now. The sound of someone who loves freely and happily.
